# Abbacy Global Group — Study Abroad & Overseas Education Consultancy

> Abbacy Global Group is a Hyderabad overseas education consultancy (est. 2019) with 7+ years of operational excellence, a 99% student visa approval rate (enrolled client applications), and 10,000+ placed alumni across top global universities in the USA, UK, Canada, Australia, Germany, Ireland, France, Netherlands, and Dubai. Headquartered at Himayatnagar, Hyderabad, Abbacy provides 100% free personalized counseling, university shortlisting across 500+ global partner institutions, test preparation waivers (IELTS/PTE/GRE), collateral-free education loans up to ₹50 Lakhs, Telangana ePASS ₹20 Lakhs scholarship assistance, and daily 1-on-1 consular mock interviews.

Last updated: 21 October 2026. Visa and fee figures follow official rules in force on that date (UKVI, IRCC, Australian Home Affairs, Campus France, DAAD).

- [Study in USA Guide](https://abbacy.in/study-in-usa.html): Complete guide to American universities, F-1 visa approvals, STEM OPT (up to 36 months work authorization), GRE waivers, Day-1 CPT policies, and average starting salaries ($85,000–$120,000/yr).

- [Study in UK Guide](https://abbacy.in/study-in-uk.html): Intensive 1-year Master's programs, Russell Group university admissions (Manchester, Birmingham, Leeds, UCL), Graduate Route work visa (2 years; 18 months for applications from January 2027), CAS issuance, and £2,000–£10,000 merit scholarships.
- [Study in Canada Guide](https://abbacy.in/study-in-canada.html): 2026/2027 IRCC rules, Provincial Attestation Letter (PAL) process, Post-Graduation Work Permit (PGWP up to 3 years), Co-op work programs, and Express Entry PR score building.

- [Indian students abroad statistics](https://abbacy.in/indian-students-abroad-statistics.html): How many Indian students study abroad in 2026? Official figures for the USA, UK, Canada, Australia and Germany, plus the Telugu-state share of US visas.

- [PTE exam fee in India](https://abbacy.in/pte-exam-fee-in-india.html): PTE exam fee in India for 2026: ₹18,900 for PTE Academic, PTE Core and PTE Academic UKVI, ₹15,300 for PTE Home, plus Pearson's reschedule and refund rules.

- [UK Graduate visa (PSW)](https://abbacy.in/uk-graduate-visa-psw.html): UK Graduate visa for Indian students: £937 fee, £1,035 a year health surcharge, 2 years if you apply by 31 Dec 2026, then 18 months from 1 Jan 2027.

- [Duolingo English Test](https://abbacy.in/duolingo-english-test-preparation.html): Duolingo English Test for Indian students: 1-hour online test, 10–160 scores, results in 2 days, 2-year validity, retake rules and a 2-week study plan.

- [Study in Germany Guide](https://abbacy.in/study-in-germany.html): Tuition-free education (€0 tuition) at public universities (TU9), mandatory APS certificate verification, €11,904/year blocked account (Ausländerbehörde requirement), and 18-month Job Seeker Visa.
- [MS in Germany Cost & Blocked Account](https://abbacy.in/ms-in-germany-cost-and-blocked-account.html): €0 tuition at most public universities, €11,904 blocked account, semester contribution and private university costs.
- [Study in Ireland Guide](https://abbacy.in/study-in-ireland.html): Europe's English-speaking tech capital (Silicon Docks Dublin), 1-year Master's, 2-year Stamp 1G post-study work visa, and fast-track Critical Skills Employment Permits.
- [Study in France Guide](https://abbacy.in/study-in-france.html): Subsidized tuition (€2,770–€3,770/yr) at public universities, Grande École business schools, CAF accommodation housing allowance (up to 40% rent rebate), and 5-year Schengen circulation visa for Indian master's alumni.
- [Study in Netherlands Guide](https://abbacy.in/study-in-netherlands.html): Over 2,100 English-taught programs, 1-year Zoekjaar (Orientation Year) work visa, high graduate employment in European tech hubs (Amsterdam, Eindhoven).
- [Study in Dubai Guide](https://abbacy.in/study-in-dubai.html): International branch campuses (Heriot-Watt, Wollongong, Birmingham, Middlesex), 0% personal income tax, fast 15-day visa approval without IELTS, and direct GCC employment opportunities.

## Specialized Dubai & UK Topical Master Guides (2026–2027)

### Dubai Topical Master Guides
- [Study in Dubai Without IELTS](https://abbacy.in/study-in-dubai-without-ielts.html): Complete guide to MOI certificates from JNTU/OU, Class 12 English waivers (65%+), and direct admissions without IELTS.
- [UAE Student Visa Process from Hyderabad](https://abbacy.in/uae-student-visa-process-hyderabad.html): Step-by-step 3 to 7 day university-sponsored GDRFA e-visa, no consulate interview, medical test and Emirates ID steps.
- [Dubai to UK & Australia Transfer Pathway](https://abbacy.in/dubai-to-uk-australia-transfer-pathway.html): 1+1 and 2+1 twinning programs. Start in Dubai with lower fees and transfer to UK/Australia parent campus with full PSW rights.
- [Top Universities in Dubai & Fees in INR](https://abbacy.in/top-universities-in-dubai-fees-for-indian-students.html): Transparent tuition fees in AED & INR for Heriot-Watt, Birmingham, UOWD, Middlesex, BITS Pilani, plus 20%–50% merit scholarships.
- [MBA in Dubai for Indian Students](https://abbacy.in/mba-in-dubai-for-indian-students.html): Top business schools (SP Jain, Edinburgh Business School, UOWD), GMAT waivers, and 0% tax corporate packages in DIFC (AED 15k–25k/mo).
- [Part-Time Jobs & Monthly Living Cost in Dubai](https://abbacy.in/part-time-jobs-and-living-cost-in-dubai.html): 20 hrs/week legal student work permits, hourly pay rates (AED 25–50/hr), and monthly student budget breakdown in INR (₹55k–₹70k).
- [Study in Dubai After 12th](https://abbacy.in/study-in-dubai-after-12th.html): Direct Bachelor's admissions (B.Tech, BBA, Architecture) without JEE Main or TS EAMCET, accepting CBSE, ICSE, and TSBIE Intermediate marks.

### United Kingdom (UK) Topical Master Guides
- [Study in UK Without IELTS](https://abbacy.in/study-in-uk-without-ielts.html): 25+ top UK universities waiving IELTS based on Class 12 English (70%+ from CBSE/ICSE/TSBIE).
- [UK Master's with Placement Year (2-Yr MS)](https://abbacy.in/uk-masters-with-placement-year.html): 1 year study + 1 year paid corporate placement (£18k–£26k) + Graduate Route (2 years, or 18 months for applications from January 2027).
- [UK Student Visa Financial Proof (28-Day Rule)](https://abbacy.in/uk-student-visa-financial-proof-28-day-rule.html): Strict UKVI maintenance guidelines: Outside London (£10,539) vs Inner London (£13,761), approved Indian banks, and education loans.
- [UK January / Spring Intake Universities](https://abbacy.in/uk-january-spring-intake-universities.html): List of 70+ UK universities open for January 2027 admissions, CAS deadlines, and avoid gap years.
- [MS in UK Cost in INR & Merit Scholarships](https://abbacy.in/ms-in-uk-cost-and-scholarships.html): Total itemized budget for 1-year Master's, living expenses, NHS healthcare surcharges, and £2,000–£10,000 automatic merit scholarships.
- [MSc Data Science & Computer Science in UK](https://abbacy.in/msc-data-science-computer-science-uk.html): Top tech universities, AI/Data curricula, conversion programs for non-CS grads, and £38k+ starting tech salaries.
- [Study in UK with Study Gap (2 to 10 Years)](https://abbacy.in/study-in-uk-after-study-gap.html): Gap justifications (corporate experience, UPSC/Govt prep, family business, medical), required documents, and gap-friendly universities.
- [Study in UK vs Study in Dubai Decider](https://abbacy.in/study-in-uk-vs-study-in-dubai.html): Direct head-to-head comparison: total cost in INR, visa speeds (3 days vs 3 weeks), 0% tax vs £11.44 min wage, and career outcomes.
